text:
Diego (Partnerships): Quick sync: NimbusGrid reached out about listing Redwood in their new 'harbor-west' region. They want a pilot with 6 reserved GPUs + cloud marketplace SKU.
Lin (Partnerships): Do they require KMS integration? any regional compliance notes?
Diego (Partnerships): They prefer customer-managed KMS for enterprise customers, but for marketplace they'd accept Redwood-managed keys initially. Also asking for usage quota metric feed to their billing system.
Omar (Cloud Ops): 6 reserved GPUs is small — we can reuse an existing west nodepool. Will need to enable marketplace entitlement mapping and permission to push AMIs. Estimate: 2 days.
Hannah (SRE): we'll need to verify network egress rules for Nimbus billing feed. Also create a lightweight canary script.
Vik (Legal): for initial Redwood-managed keys we need an opt-in clause for customers later to migrate to own KMS. I'll draft a short addendum.
Diego (Partnerships): Nimbus suggested SKU label: redwood-inference.harbor-west.beta.
Diego (Partnerships): copy of their email snippet: 
```
proposed_sku: redwood-inference.harbor-west.beta
quota_reserved: 6
quota_burst: 18
billing_integration: api-feed-v1
```
Omar (Cloud Ops): Can we supply the billing feed endpoint? Hannah, can you handle test webhook for their staging?
Hannah (SRE): Yep, will spin up webhook consumer in staging and validate event schema. Need Nimbus staging creds.
PartnerBot: ticket #PRT-2255 created and assigned to Diego, Omar, Hannah.
Lin (Partnerships): I'll confirm Nimbus legal contact for the opt-in KMS clause. Diego, can you confirm target soft-launch date?
Diego (Partnerships): They asked for mid-next-month, but flexible. Let's aim for two-week timeline to get staging validated.
Omar (Cloud Ops): if we push AMI and entitlement mapping this week we can be ready in 10 business days.
Vik (Legal): I'll prepare the KMS opt-in addendum and share by EOD+3.
Diego (Partnerships): Thanks everyone. I'll post Nimbus contact and confirm staging creds in the thread when I have them. :pray:
